description:
Configure email authentication for the domain 'localbiz.test' to improve deliverability and prevent spoofing. In the Virtualmin control panel (https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), navigate to the DNS Records for 'localbiz.test' and add the following two TXT records:

1. An SPF record for the root domain ('localbiz.test') with the value:
   v=spf1 a mx ip4:127.0.0.1 ~all

2. A DMARC record for the subdomain '_dmarc.localbiz.test' with the value:
   v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:admin@localbiz.test; pct=100

Apply the configuration to ensure the records are active.
